title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
text: Component Maintenance Manual, revision C. Kestrel Industrial (fictional demo data).

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 1 General Description
text: The KP-200 is an end-suction, single-stage centrifugal pump for clean water and light process fluids at up to 120 m3/h and 9 bar. A 22 kW four-pole motor drives the pump shaft through a flexible coupling (KP-200-140).

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 1.1 Components
text: The main components are the pump casing (KP-200-101), the impeller (KP-200-120) held by the impeller nut (KP-200-121), the shaft (KP-200-110) with its shaft sleeve (KP-200-111), the mechanical seal assembly (KP-200-114) and two deep-groove ball bearings (KP-200-130) in the bearing housing, each protected by a bearing lip seal (KP-200-131). The casing joint is sealed by the casing O-ring (KP-200-115).

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 1.2 Controls and Indicating
text: A pressure gauge (KP-200-150) on the discharge flange shows the delivery pressure. The motor starter has a local start/stop station and an emergency stop. A dry-run protection relay stops the motor when the suction pressure stays below 0.3 bar for more than 10 seconds.

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 1.3 Interfaces
text: Suction flange DN100, discharge flange DN80, both PN16. The seal flush line is taken from the discharge side through a 6 mm orifice. The baseplate is grouted to the foundation.

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 1.4 Power Supply
text: The motor is supplied at 415 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz through a star-delta starter rated 45 A. The dry-run relay is supplied at 24 V DC from the control panel.

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 2 Specifications
text:
| Item                | Value                   |
|---------------------|-------------------------|
| Rated flow          | 120 m3/h                |
| Rated head          | 62 m                    |
| Speed               | 1475 rpm                |
| Max casing pressure | 16 bar                  |
| Impeller nut torque | 95 Nm                   |
| Casing bolt torque  | 55 Nm, cross pattern    |
| Bearing grease      | Lithium complex, NLGI 2 |

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 3 Maintenance Schedule
text:
| Interval   | Task                             |   Section |
|------------|----------------------------------|-----------|
| Weekly     | Check for seal leakage and noise |         5 |
| Every 2000 h   | Lubricate bearings (15 g each)      |   4.3 |
|----------------|-------------------------------------|-------|
| Every 8000 h   | Inspect impeller and wear clearance |   4.2 |
| On leakage     | Replace mechanical seal             |   4.1 |

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 4.1 Mechanical Seal Replacement
text:
Warning: isolate the motor electrically and lock out the starter. Close the suction and discharge valves and drain the casing before you start.

- 1. Remove the coupling guard and disconnect the flexible coupling (KP-200-140).
- 2. Remove the casing bolts and withdraw the back pull-out unit from the casing.
- 3. Remove the impeller nut (KP-200-121) and pull the impeller (KP-200-120) off the shaft.
- 4. Remove the seal cover and slide the old mechanical seal assembly (KP-200-114) off the shaft sleeve.
- 5. Inspect the shaft sleeve (KP-200-111) for scoring. Replace the sleeve if the wear groove is deeper than 0.1 mm.
- 6. Clean the seal chamber and lightly lubricate the new seal faces with clean water. Do not use grease on the faces.
- 7. Fit the new mechanical seal assembly (KP-200-114) and set the seal working length to 42.5 mm.
- 8. Refit the impeller and torque the impeller nut to 95 Nm.
- 9. Fit a new casing O-ring (KP-200-115) and refit the back pull-out unit. Torque the casing bolts to 55 Nm in a cross pattern.
- 10. Reconnect the coupling, check alignment (maximum 0.05 mm offset) and refit the guard.

Test: open the valves, vent the casing and run the pump for 30 minutes. The seal must not leak more than 5 drops per minute after the first 10 minutes.

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 4.2 Impeller Inspection and Replacement
text:
- 1. Isolate, drain and remove the back pull-out unit as in steps 1 and 2 of section 4.1.
- 2. Measure the wear-ring clearance. Replace the impeller (KP-200-120) if the diametral clearance exceeds 0.9 mm.
- 3. Check the vanes for cavitation pitting deeper than 2 mm.
- 4. Fit the impeller with a new impeller nut (KP-200-121) and torque to 95 Nm.

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 4.3 Bearing Lubrication
text: Lubricate each bearing (KP-200-130) every 2000 operating hours with 15 g of lithium complex grease, NLGI 2, through the grease nipples while the pump runs. Do not over-grease: bearing temperature above 85 C after lubrication means too much grease.

title: Kestrel KP-200 Centrifugal Pump
heading: 5 Troubleshooting
text:
| Symptom               | Likely cause                  | Action                       |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------------|
| Seal leaks steadily   | Worn seal faces or sleeve     | Replace seal (4.1)           |
| Low delivery pressure | Worn impeller, air in suction | Inspect impeller (4.2), vent |
| Hot bearings          | Over-greasing, misalignment   | Check grease quantity, align |

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
text: Operation and Maintenance Manual, revision B. Kestrel Industrial (fictional demo data).

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: 1 General Description
text: The KC-50 is a two-stage, belt-driven piston compressor delivering 50 m3/h of free air at up to 10 bar into a 270 L receiver. A 7.5 kW motor drives the crankcase (KC-50-201) through two drive belts (KC-50-240).

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: 1.1 Components
text: Crankcase (KC-50-201), valve plate assembly (KC-50-230), intake air filter element (KC-50-210), safety relief valve (KC-50-250) set at 11 bar, and two motor bearings (KC-50-260).

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: 1.2 Controls and Indicating
text: A pressure switch starts the compressor at 8 bar and stops it at 10 bar. An oil level sight glass is fitted on the crankcase.

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: 1.3 Power Supply
text: 415 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz through a direct-on-line starter with thermal overload set at 15 A.

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: 2 Maintenance Schedule
text:
| Interval     | Task                           |   Section |
|--------------|--------------------------------|-----------|
| Daily        | Drain receiver condensate      |       3.4 |
| Every 500 h  | Clean or replace intake filter |       3.1 |
| Every 1000 h | Change compressor oil          |       3.2 |
| Every 4000 h | Lubricate motor bearings       |       3.3 |

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: 3.1 Intake Filter Replacement
text:
- 1. Stop the compressor and isolate the motor.
- 2. Unscrew the filter housing cover.
- 3. Replace the filter element (KC-50-210) and refit the cover hand-tight.

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: 3.2 Oil Change
text:
- 1. Run the compressor for 10 minutes to warm the oil, then isolate it.
- 2. Drain the oil through the crankcase drain plug.
- 3. Refill with 2 L of compressor oil (KC-50-220) to the middle of the sight glass.

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: 3.3 Motor Bearing Lubrication
text: Lubricate the motor bearings (KC-50-260) every 4000 operating hours with 8 g of polyurea grease each. Bearings are lubricated with the motor stopped.

title: Kestrel KC-50 Piston Air Compressor
heading: 3.4 Condensate Drain
text: Open the receiver drain valve daily until only air comes out.

title: KESTREL INDUSTRIAL -SERVICE BULLETIN SB-07
heading: KESTREL INDUSTRIAL -SERVICE BULLETIN SB-07
text:
Subject: KP-200 mechanical seal, improved design Applies to: KP-200 pumps, serial numbers 2200 to 2650

Reason: early seal face wear has been reported on pumps running with abrasive water above 40 C.

Action: when the mechanical seal is next replaced, fit the improved seal assembly KP-200-114B instead of KP-200-114. Set the working length to 43.0 mm. The casing O-ring KP-200-115 must also be replaced.

Compliance:

at the next seal replacement.
